'''Uunos Gooru''' was a [[Trade Baron]] within the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]].<ref name="Rogues Gallery" /> By [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], prior to the Trade Federation's [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|invasion]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]],<ref name="TNEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> Gooru's biography was written by [[Viff Almay]], the [[Trade Federation Occupation Council]]'s [[chronicler]]. Almay won the [[Golden Pylat Award]] for writing Gooru's biography.<ref name="Rogues Gallery" />

==Behind the scenes==
Uunos Gooru was mentioned in "[[Rogues Gallery (department)|The Devious Neimoidians Revealed]]," an article written for the [[Star Wars Insider 147|147th issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars Insider]]'' magazine,<ref name="Rogues Gallery" /> which was released on [[January 21]], [[2014]].<ref name="Titan">{{TitanMagazines|url=t/star-wars-insider/us/147|text=Star Wars Insider Issue #147}}</ref>
